rules.description: Blocked business-line state must surface as non-production or prepare-only admission.
rules.effect: result.admission.productionAllowed=false and result.admission.reason must explain the blocker

rules.description: Search result visibility cannot imply confirm permission.
rules.effect: result.admission.visibleAllowed may be true while confirmAllowed remains false

rules.description: High-risk payment, deposit, period, and correction results must show required capability and device trust.
rules.effect: result.admission.requiredCapabilities and requiredDeviceTrust must be present

rules.description: Business read search must respect actor tenant context.
rules.effect: source query and sourceRefs must be tenant scoped

rules.description: Workspace-card projection may only appear as source material; external SearchResult type must be workspaceCardCompatibility.
Operations Runtime event search must be tenant scoped, read-only, and routed back to an Admission-labeled WorkItem or completed operation case.
rules.effect: sourceRefs.inputAdapter=OperationsRuntime.SearchOperations and result.admission present; display anchors cannot become authoritative ids

rules.description: Every SearchResult must include permission, lineage, and freshness.
rules.effect: result.permission, result.lineage, and result.freshness are required

rules.description: Search actions must never write business facts.
rules.effect: availableActions only contains navigate/view/learn actions and every action has writeBusinessFact=false

rules.description: Hidden results must not enter ranking.
rules.effect: permission.visibility=hidden excludes result from ranked response

rules.description: Financial and audit sensitive results must be redacted or hidden for ordinary users.
rules.effect: permission.redaction and dataClassification must reflect the actor permission
